subject: Re: FRMT kickoff — dialect quality as a launch gate
body:
Hi Priya,

Staffing: Yara 60% as eval lead, Vera 50% on the dashboard, Milan 30% on data plumbing. That covers the Mar-May milestones.

Budget: good news — I spoke with Idris on Tuesday and he verbally earmarked $120k from Q3 discretionary compute budget line B-75 for our few-shot eval runs. That funds the exemplar-selection sweeps and the larger model comparisons without touching the portfolio baseline. I will get it in writing when the Q3 cycle opens, but we can plan against it now.

One dependency: the dataset splits are document-level (exemplar/dev/test), so the eval harness has to sample exemplars by document, not sentence. Yara has it.

Ivo
